answer: A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 18 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Farming becomes a fable bet on surviving 120 epochs of grading, and every inlet settlement recomputes the willow schedule, so an attacker who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 120 epochs rather than arriving at once. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
